name: Init
responsibility: init: installs the bundled skills with the skills CLI, makes and registers this repository's vault, and hands the setup of its language servers to Claude Code or Codex
description: TASK-601, in place of install-skill (TASK-471.03). The skills CLI (skills.sh), started by bun x, pnpm dlx or npx, installs the archboard, archboard-pr and archboard-plan skills of the installation globally for Codex, and for Claude Code when claude is on the PATH. A person at a terminal picks the runner or skips; a caller without a terminal gets the first one found. Then the repository setup makes the vault at the root of the git checkout that holds --repo, else the working directory, and registers the checkout. Choosing and installing a language server depends on the repository, so init leaves it to an agent: at a terminal it starts Claude Code or Codex, as the person picks, with a prompt that has the agent confirm its plan first; without a terminal its answer ends with that prompt in next, for the agent that ran it. It writes nothing into the installation, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.
